main.interpretation: expected total, no truncation/conditioning of Poisson counts

primary.weights: equal cells; equal scenes within cell
primary.success: positive estimate and percentile 95% CI excludes zero
primary.missing_pair_rule: Any missing/invalid pair blocks primary inference; report incomplete descriptive results without replacement.

endpoints.delay: mean 25*(completed_at-release) over on-time completions; NA if none
endpoints.latency: per-episode mean complete scheduler call wall seconds over all 100 allocation ticks, including no-ops; physics/I/O excluded; single core per episode; event-only selector tails separate
endpoints.missing: complete pairs for undefined endpoints; report n/cell, p=1 if a cell has no pairs

cells.panel_rule: 10 consecutive seeds per panel in fixed location-major/date-minor order
cells.blocked_by: history-only adapter and frozen six-panel forcing manifest

cells.panel_rule: 10 consecutive seeds per panel in fixed location-major/date-minor order
cells.blocked_by: history-only adapter and frozen six-panel forcing manifest

robustness.multiplicity: Holm across six cell TCR contrasts; conditional HYCOM panels

hycom.replacement_rule: none; unavailable/invalid panels block module or pre-data amendment

bootstrap.wind_anchor: resample paired scenes within each cell
bootstrap.hycom: resample paired scenes within each U/location/date panel, then equally weight six panels within U
bootstrap.p_value: centered paired-bootstrap two-sided; Holm across six robustness cells

variants.change_scope: scoring continuation only; live event and dispatch unchanged

ablations.endpoint_alias_cost_scope: trigger_0 and never_trigger are full/base policy endpoints without network overhead, not timed executions of trigger wrappers; all three executed positive thresholds include MLP inference
ablations.r1_note: K16 and 0.5/1.0 trigger thresholds removed; full_k8/base_only aliases avoid duplicate execution.

analysis.model: descriptive paired-difference regressions on log physical speed ratio and expected tasks/U, interactions; separate domains
analysis.scope: USV-like kinematics, UAV energy bookkeeping retained

seed_policy.one_shot: one generation per seed, all frozen arms from immutable saved scenario; no replacement or re-launch
seed_policy.audit_replay: read saved scenario only, not a new experimental generation

drl.status: option B and R2 adopted; training governed by separately authorized frozen inputs

training.mixture: equal 6 task-load/arrival cells within each U
training.continuation: checkpoint optimizer and RNG; no fresh-start retry; stage count = ceil(measured budget/6h) per selected adapter

evaluation.scene_summary: mean of 3 fixed training initializations, also each separately
evaluation.status: rules frozen; checkpoints pending; timing allowance provisional
evaluation.inference_scope: conditional on the three frozen training initializations; report initialization-specific values
evaluation.timing: after main completion, sealed main scene bytes only; never generate
evaluation.checkpoint_hashes: append all 12 final hashes before evaluation; production rule already frozen
evaluation.aggregation: within scene arithmetic mean of all three initialization outcomes; all three required

not_applicable.reason: hidden-total leakage and incompatible Poisson dimensions

unavailable.condition: verified author source cannot be restored

resources.cost_status: measured production; conservative projected replay and unmeasured variants
resources.audit_allowance: independent replay included; conservative and explicitly estimated where not timed
resources.formal_cpu_affinity: pin lane i to reserved CPU i; numerical libraries single-threaded; record model, CPU IDs, versions and utilization
resources.latency_scope: throughput execution on the specified nine-core host; hardware/load declared, no hard real-time guarantee

throughput_choice.scope: full u4/n80/high old-seed reference; integer pool packing; not a direct nine-identical-episode race

resources.independent_replay_allowance: max(2*production, measured physical/reward/loss audit); additional 5 seconds I/O per episode

budget.schedule: main then non-learned supplementary modules; learned evaluation after main on sealed bytes when all twelve final checkpoints are appended; one batch at a time; dual archive before next
budget.unmeasured_variant_factors: robustness/availability/analysis 2x respective production; b_fc 32x b times max(1, integer-intercept-bound ratio to speed .05); historical WP2B-2b b_fc/b episode ratio was 12.9 on local hardware, not a server measurement; new ablations 2x max(1,K/8); audit 2x all projected production; must replace if preflight shows insufficient
budget.learned_eval_schedule: per adapter: six 180-episode batches, 3900s prediction/21600s cap, 9 single-core lanes; allowance 60s inference +60s audit per episode, 50% margin +300s overhead
budget.aggregate_cap_rule: authorization must bind aggregate seconds within approved scope; 408 sum-of-batch cap hours is not separately authorized

prerequisites: review full protocol and frozen release
real-current history-only adapter and metadata stripping
six HYCOM forcing panels and immutable manifest
K1/K4/K8 and branch/suffix/deferred-off implementations preserving full K8
WP3g trigger integration and checkpoint availability
metric/latency instrumentation and frozen statistics/table generator
seed ledger scan and one-shot launch guards
DRL choice, repair, old-seed inference/training cost benchmark and frozen weights

integrity.failures: retain claim; no seed substitution, automatic retries or silent exclusions
required_audits: policy and sampled suffixes independent of production
integrity.effects_blinded_until: Non-learned main tables allowed after all main arms/audits complete, before learned evaluation. No partial-batch effects. Learned rules remain immutable; final Holm family always 25 (unavailable tests p=1).
integrity.approval_scope: One supervisor/user authorization may cover all named frozen batch manifests; do not request repeated approval within that scope. New scope or changed hashes require a pre-data amendment.
